messages:
sanjay: PTAL — I pushed a small reorg of the async dispatch (moved RetryScheduler -> runtime/async), fixed a shutdown race, and tightened the backoff on the hot path (50ms -> 10ms). Added a migration script for nodes with long-lived workers. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1234

emma: nice, can you add a quick smoke script for Dedicated so SRE can run a short verification? otherwise looks straightforward.

sanjay: added scripts/smoke/dedicated_smoke.sh and updated the README. Run with:
```
./scripts/smoke/dedicated_smoke.sh --short
```
It does ~100 requests and checks token latency/p95 thresholds. Also added a conservative canary fallback in the rollout config.

ci-bot: CI: all checks passed — unit tests: 452 passed, integration: 68 passed, perf checks: baseline within 98%. (build 7821)

morgan: quick q: will this change affect KV cache eviction timing? saw a small eviction bump in staging earlier.

sanjay: good catch — it shouldn't change eviction logic. The staging bump was the race causing requests to queue longer; after this fix in staging the in-flight time drops and eviction rate should decrease. I added an e2e that asserts eviction_count doesn't grow unexpectedly and a note in the PR.

emma: :thumbsup: I'll run the dedicated smoke now. If green, can we schedule canary this afternoon?

deploy-bot: Canary op scheduled by @emma for 2026-03-20 15:00 PST. Notify #eng-oncall if any regressions are observed.

morgan: ptal @sanjay — left two tiny nits inline (naming + a clarifying comment). non-blocking.

sanjay: addressed the two nits and squashed. PTAL again when you get a sec. Ping me if you want to pair during the canary.

emma: running smoke now... green ✅. pushing canary.

sanjay: thanks everyone — I will monitor metrics and rollback if anything spikes. closing thread once canary is stable.
